turns.speaker: host
turns.text: National Weather Service notice 638 forecasts 2 to 3 meter surf on BCS western coast, POSTA México reported on November 16.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? Those waves hit from Guerrero Negro through Todos Santos and Puerto San Carlos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The same notice adds 30 to 50 km per hour gusts over the Gulf of California.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That raises risks for small boats right away, especially after the earlier closures.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Earlier this month the Navy closed five ports during cold front 4.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: At the same time La Paz installed its third community composter in El Palmar II, Diario Humano reports.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That unit joins two others and turns organic waste into compost for local parks with Semarnat support.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The programme also delivered 40 home composters to families already, which helps scale the effort.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's data shows ten federal ANP polygons on the state map, yet enforcement questions remain.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: This is Radio BCS2050. On Environment we ask how these weather events and local waste projects affect the state's coastal protections and daily resilience. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly the details worth tracking week by week. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: POSTA México reports that National Weather Service notice 638 forecasts 2 to 3 meter surf on the Pacific coast.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That covers spots like Guerrero Negro, Bahía Asunción and Puerto San Carlos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Small craft operators will need to watch those conditions closely this week. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? Fishers who head out daily from Puerto Adolfo López Mateos might have to stay in.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Earlier this month cold front 4 already forced the Navy to close several ports to small boats.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The new notice adds 30 to 50 kilometer per hour gusts over the Gulf of California too.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That combination raises the risk for anyone heading out in a smaller vessel.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mm. I wonder how many trips get canceled when both waves and wind hit at once.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Palabra BCS says cold front 7 is now moving in with showers and stronger winds.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Rain totals of 5 to 25 millimeters are expected across the Pacífico Norte.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Paz could see its first night drop to 17 degrees this season.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Lows of 16 to 17 degrees are also forecast for the Santo Domingo valley.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: How do those temperature swings affect daily work for people in the valley?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Farmers might need extra blankets for seedlings when the nights turn cooler so fast.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Diario Humano has a different story from La Paz this week.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The city just installed its third community composter at Centro Impulso in El Palmar II.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The first two were already running in Solidaridad and Los Mangos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The program works with Semarnat, the Pacific Alliance Cooperation Fund and GeoCiclos from Chile.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They have already given 40 home composters to families and plan more sites.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Fundadores park in El Centenario and La Cima are next on the list.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The idea is to turn organic waste into compost that can be used on local green areas.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That could cut down on what ends up in the landfill each week.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Nigua reports on another environmental check in Todos Santos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: On 11 November Profepa inspected the Hotel San Cristóbal in Punta Lobos after a wall collapse.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The Tres Santos project had reported the demolition of damaged sections.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: No wastewater or chemical discharges reached the sea and no wildlife was harmed.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Profepa will now review the environmental impact permit and waste handling plans.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They may order a full inspection if any rules were missed.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It is still unclear whether the demolition work was covered by the original permit. [pause]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I keep thinking about how these small checks add up over time.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly. One rule at a time keeps the coast clearer. [breath]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What would you ask the families using the home composters first?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: How the compost actually changes their garden soil after a few months.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That practical detail would tell us if the program is working day to day. [laugh]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: POSTA México reports that the National Weather Service issued notice 638 this week.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The notice focuses on conditions along the Pacific coast of Baja California Sur.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It forecasts surf heights of 2 to 3 meters.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That level already limits operations for small boats in exposed areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The same notice lists Guerrero Negro, Bahía Asunción and Puerto San Carlos among the affected ports.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Puerto San Carlos sits inside Comondú municipality, while Guerrero Negro lies in the northern Mulegé corridor.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Winds are expected to reach 30 to 50 kilometers per hour over the Gulf of California.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those gusts add another layer of risk for crews working from those same harbors.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Earlier in November the Navy closed several ports to small craft during cold front 4.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Santa Rosalía, Loreto, San Carlos, Bahía Magdalena and López Mateos were all shut down at that time.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Repeated closures show how marine weather quickly changes daily plans for fishers in Comondú and Mulegé north.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Diario Humano reports that La Paz installed its third community composter on 16 November.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The new unit is located at Centro Impulso in the El Palmar II neighborhood.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Two earlier composters already operate in Solidaridad and Los Mangos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Fundadores park in El Centenario and La Cima are scheduled next.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The project works with Semarnat, the Pacific Alliance Cooperation Fund and GeoCiclos from Chile.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 40 home composters were also given to families in the same programme.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Organic waste collected at these sites becomes compost used on city green areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Residents in La Paz now have a growing local route for kitchen scraps that avoids the landfill.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: These two stories on the same day touch different parts of the state yet both affect daily routines in Comondú, Mulegé north and La Paz.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One changes boat schedules, the other changes how households handle waste. [pause]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Both show how environmental services already shape ordinary decisions for people living in these municipalities.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Comondú also runs agri pilots that depend on steady irrigation and desal trials.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: A sudden closure can delay harvest transport that normally moves through Puerto San Carlos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mulegé north holds the recent CFE Oasis H2 announcement from September 2026.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Remote energy projects there still need reliable port access during the same weather windows.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: In La Paz the new composter sits in a neighborhood already using the first two units.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Each site turns household scraps into material that directly feeds municipal parks.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That loop reduces landfill pressure while giving residents one concrete step they can take at home.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The programme even plans two more locations before the end of the year.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Weather events and waste systems therefore land on the same calendar for these three areas. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: One forces quick adaptation at sea, the other builds a slower habit on land.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Meganoticias reported on 14 November that Miguel Imaz at UABCS warned El Niño is raising sea levels in Puerto San Carlos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: In Comondú municipality.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly, and it has lifted waves by 15 to 30 centimetres.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is enough to collapse natural barriers and let seawater in.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Tribuna de México added on 7 November that the UABCS risk lab now forecasts tides up to 2.55 metres in Bahía Magdalena through late December.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those tides could hit San Carlos, Puerto Cortés and Puerto Chale.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: HOY BCS noted on 11 November that the same waves exposed the foundations of Hotel San Cristóbal at Punta Lobos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Forcing partial demolition on 10 November.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Fishers there flagged the erosion risk since 2015, yet no official technical report exists yet.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The portal's November Foresight ties these events to the coastal ceiling flagged after Hurricanes Polo and Rachel.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That thread runs through the Sea of Cortez Forum in Tus Buenas Noticias, where leaders discussed limits to development.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Meganoticias reported on 12 November that FEDECOOP and the BCS government presented Shell Nurse artificial reefs in La Paz Bay.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: A fisheries response to warming waters.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Secihti is funding the assessment, while IDB, IMIPAS and CISIMAR run the cost-benefit study.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Tribuna de México reported on 11 November that whale-shark tours remain on hold because Conanp has not recorded the required six animals.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Operators blame El Niño-altered temperatures.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Gringo Gazette reported on 2 November that Semarnat approved the Camarón Beach project northwest of La Paz despite impacts on 30.96 hectares.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The permit clears about 10.54 hectares after 14 objections.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: HCN reported on 29 October that Deputy Erick Agúndez introduced a bill to let municipalities manage ecological reserves.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It would amend article 106 of the state ecological law at ejido request.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The knowledge graph shows these sites already carry DOF notices for Cabo Pulmo, Bahía de Loreto and El Vizcaíno.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet no new polygons appear in the base de datos BCS 2050 atlas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The hidden thread is therefore the existing management-programme catalogue rather than fresh territorial layers.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: But here's the surprise turn: the same foresight note that lists SIBCS as an energy island also flags water, port and social-housing pressures reopening the territorial debate.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So the coastal-erosion question now sits inside the larger infrastructure discussion for 2050. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Meganoticias reported on 3 November that Zofemat removed over 350 tyres from El Médano after the rains.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Plus 18 tonnes of rubbish washed from illegal dumps.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That cleanup will take another ten days.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's earlier October foresight already paired grid reliability with coastal resilience.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mm. I keep wondering what the municipalities would actually do with those new powers if the bill passes.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Did you know the Reserva de la Biosfera El Vizcaíno covers 2,546,790.25 hectares?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That is the figure in the ambiente guide from the portal.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It was decreed on 30 November 1988.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: A decree from that year still shapes what can happen along the coast today.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It takes up about 77 percent of Mulegé municipality.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 77 percent of one municipality is a large share of the land use map.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Sixteen núcleo zones sit inside it.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Those núcleo zones total roughly that area.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: UNESCO listed it in 1993 as a whale refuge in the lagoons and for the rock paintings in the Sierra de San Francisco.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That protection matters because the same area now faces extra pressure from higher waves.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Miguel Imaz at UABCS told Meganoticias that El Niño is adding 15 to 30 centimetres of wave height at Puerto San Carlos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Fifteen centimetres does not sound like much until it hits the protective levee during a storm.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Polo already breached that levee and flooded roads and water systems in Comondú and Mulegé.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The protected status does not stop the water, but it limits how much new building can go in the way.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The portal also lists the Sierra de la Laguna as another protected area of 112,437.07 hectares.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Its núcleo zone of about 32,520 hectares is described as the main recharge area for aquifers in the south of the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the same rules that keep the land open also keep the water supply steadier for towns below it.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal calls these ANPs an overlay rather than a single land-tenure class.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That means the maps sit on top of whatever else is happening, whether tourism plans or storm repairs. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The question left open is how the new regional growth targets will line up with those overlays.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The POERBCS document lists 56 UGAs that set land-use policies across Baja California Sur.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those policies are named Aprovechamiento Sustentable, Preservación and Protección.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The ontology labels this package dq_cambio_uso_suelo and ties it directly to the 56 units.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Any project must check those units before a change of land use can move forward.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The same package also points planners to the PDU and PSDU of each municipality.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So a desaladora or hotel corridor cannot simply appear on the map.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It has to pass the viability test labelled dq_viabilidad_proyecto.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That test bundles water from DMA and aquifers, energy from SIBCS and CFE, plus ANP limits.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The risks package dq_riesgos_principales adds marine intrusion and seismic layers from SSN.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those layers sit behind every corridor decision even when residents never see the maps.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One everyday object that reveals the system is the water meter on a new coastal home.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Behind that meter runs the full chain of aquifer capacity, desal supply and POERBCS policy.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The 2010 meta-analysis by Ewing and Cervero showed density and design affect travel demand.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Their elasticity numbers still guide how much road or parking must accompany each new unit.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Street Design from 2013 adds the practical retrofits needed for hot-climate cores.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: All of it sits in the same hidden stack that decides whether a project receives its permit.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The question left open is how often the 56 UGAs are updated when new census data arrive.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That update cycle determines whether the rules stay ahead of the next proposal.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The 1993 Calthorpe book already framed compact regionalism for corridors like this one.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet the ontology still flags tenencia and intrusión as open variables in every viability check.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Loreto Municipality ties directly to Bahía de Loreto National Park with its DOF notice from 11 Nov 2002.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mulegé holds the largest area and must balance mining, fishing and the El Vizcaíno Reserve decree from 30 Nov 1988.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Cabo Pulmo keeps its 13 Nov 2009 notice on top of the original 6 Jun 1995 park decree.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those fixed dates mean any new project still faces the same ANP restrictions listed in the knowledge graph.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What would you ask the next planner who opens that dq_viabilidad_proyecto file? [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal’s Vision for coast and climate flags a clear risk already visible along Baja California Sur’s shoreline.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Surge, erosion and flooding are prompting reviews of buildings placed too close to the water.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: UABCS measurements during the latest El Niño show wave heights rising 15 to 30 centimetres at Puerto San Carlos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is the documented finding. The portal notes there is still no reliable series long enough to project a 2050 shoreline.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So the aspiration stays general: a habitable, regenerative coast that restores barriers and beaches before allowing new occupation.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: One lever is finishing the environmental reviews already open, such as the case of Hotel San Cristóbal at Punta Lobos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The idea is to keep debris and precedent from being washed away by the next event.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Another lever is placing relocation and retreat at the front of decisions rather than after the next surge.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal also stresses respecting ANP and coastal-planning limits before scaling hospitality in East Cape, Loreto or the Pacific corridor.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Toward 2050 the reading that still stands is a polycentric system rather than one coastal formula repeated from south to north.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos would keep its tourism role but under water and power stress.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: East Cape stays in tension with protected areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Todos Santos and El Pescadero form the Pacific amenity spine.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz acts as the service capital and water-energy node.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Loreto remains a tourism-conservation anchor.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Comondú keeps its agricultural role with relatively more room.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Northern Mulegé appears as a thinly documented corridor that now has a remote generation tender.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The conditions for that outcome are straightforward.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Each area keeps its distinct role instead of diluting the Los Cabos model across the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: New tourism or residential growth only where water and energy show real margin or come from non-DMA sources such as desal.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: East Cape and Loreto must respect ANP and POEL ceilings before any further scaling.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Comondú and the north can add production and energy without emptying services or protected areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The watchlist item right now is the technical finding and Profepa review of the environmental authorisation at Punta Lobos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I keep thinking about how those separate regional roles actually add up to a stronger state than one uniform plan.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That is the open question the portal leaves us with.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: An UABCS researcher warns that El Niño is raising sea levels around Puerto San Carlos and will keep causing unusual high tides.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That warning lines up with what happened at the Hotel San Cristóbal in Punta Lobos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Part of the hotel was taken down after wave damage. Local fishers had already pointed out the risk.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Now crews are watching the debris so none of it reaches the water. [pause]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The portal's aspiration is a coast that stays livable by restoring beaches and barriers first.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: And by stepping back from risky spots before any new building starts. What changes for BCS is that every coastal plan has to treat erosion and high tides as normal.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Who carries that out? Local authorities and the developers who pick the next sites.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal gives the goal without any modelled shoreline for later years. That part stays open.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: We have the warning and the demolition on record. We still do not have the exact future line.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: [chuckle] So the point is straightforward. Use what the researcher and the fishers already told us and plan the coast that way now.
